local_checks.invariant: A title accepted by set_project_title cannot carry a terminal control sequence into paint_group_header. Skipping terminal_text is not a boundary break for that title.
local_checks.result: group_key labels a project with ProjectNames::name. paint_group_header puts that word in a raw span and does not call terminal_text. An accepted title has no char::is_control, so the raw span matches an escaped one. Load and restore_project_title do not re-run the refusal, so a same-user edit of tsk.json can place controls in a title the header paints raw. Unix state files are mode 0600. That editor is the terminal owner. Bidi can be stored and is painted raw; terminal_text would also leave it.

hardening: paint_group_header does not call terminal_text. Load does not re-apply project_title_refusal. Same-user store edit is not a second principal.
